systems.system: SuperApp based on Verifiable Digital Credentials in a Secure ID Wallet (request for information, launched 2025-09-11)
systems.platform: blockchain, to be proposed by the bidder; self-sovereign identity with selective disclosure
systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation
systems.tiers: planned citizen wallet expected to hold nine documents, among them the Mobile ID, the birth certificate and the marriage certificate

note: A procurement clarification of 2025-10-02 for a planned wallet that would hold the birth certificate as a credential; a system not yet built, and nothing on how or where births and deaths are registered.
